justification_span.verbatim: First thing, packaging. The cap doesn't click shut properly yaar. I've had it open in my gym bag and leak twice now.

scores.rationale: Concrete product failure causing waste and frustration, explicitly compared unfavorably to competitors, blocks full recommendation.

justification_span.verbatim: 48 hour is just a marketing line, koi nahi karta itna last.

scores.rationale: Customer explicitly calls out the brand's core claim as false marketing — direct trust violation that blocks full recommendation.

justification_span.verbatim: Bilkul. Office mein Wildstone strong scent thoda awkward lagta hai. Imagine kar, meeting mein 5 log baithe hain and Bombshell Bombshell smell aa rahi hai - it's like college boy vibe. Office mein Nivea zyada appropriate.

scores.rationale: Blocks entire office use case (major occasion), customer already switched to competitor (Nivea) for this segment.

justification_span.verbatim: Definitely. Agar same brand mein "Wildstone Office" type SKU launch karein, subtle scent, premium packaging - I would buy. ₹400-500 mein bhi okay hai if quality matches.

scores.rationale: Concrete revenue opportunity with explicit willingness to pay premium (₹400-500), addresses office use-case blocker.

justification_span.verbatim: Haan because that's different category na. Like cologne almost. For regular casual deo ₹250 ceiling hai. But office context mein I'm comparing against Nivea ₹400, so ₹400-500 is fine.

scores.rationale: Reveals pricing elasticity for premium variants — insight for segmentation strategy, not a blocker.

justification_span.verbatim: Honestly the smell I liked. Ultra Sensual, Bombshell, those scents are like... they have character. Axe felt very teenage, you know? But Wildstone feels more grown up, more masculine.

scores.rationale: Positive brand strength, reinforces existing positioning — maintain, not fix.

justification_span.verbatim: Yeah recently I bought Nivea Men Cool Kick for office use. That one I keep on my office desk. It's lighter, more subtle, more professional smell. Wildstone weekend pe use karta hoon, gym mein, casual outings.

scores.rationale: Behavioral insight showing portfolio opportunity, but customer already adapted with competitor — moderate opportunity cost.

justification_span.verbatim: Younger guys are discovering Beardo from reels and influencers. Wildstone needs to up their digital game.

scores.rationale: Competitors capturing discovery and younger segments via digital channels where Wildstone is absent — acquisition risk.

justification_span.verbatim: hmm... I think 2 years ho gaye honge. Pehle Axe use karta tha college mein, then switched to Wildstone because friends recommended.

scores.rationale: Positive historical acquisition signal, no current pain point or action needed.

justification_span.verbatim: Honestly agar packaging fix kar dein and slightly better longevity, then full recommendation. Right now it's like 70% recommend.

scores.rationale: Explicit NPS-style qualifier tied to packaging and longevity fixes — quantified advocacy blocker.
